message.content:
A magazine cover features a large red masthead "TEMPO" with the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Above the masthead are two text blurbs: "Penyelamatan Garuda Via Danantara H.84" and "Mode Berkelanjutan Tak Berkelanjutan H.50". To the right of the masthead is a stylized "51" logo. Below the masthead, bold black text reads "PARA PERUSAK RAJA AMPAT", followed by a two-line caption: "Menteri Bahlil Lahadalia menerbitkan izin tambang nikel di Raja Ampat. Melanggar Undang-Undang Pengelolaan Wilayah Pesisir dan Pulau-Pulau Kecil. H.26".

The central illustration depicts a scenic tropical bay with turquoise water and numerous limestone karst islands topped with green vegetation. A large, semi-transparent blue excavator is positioned in the foreground on a rocky outcrop. A man with dark hair and skin, wearing a white shirt and a yellow safety vest, sits inside the excavator’s cab. The excavator’s bucket arm extends over the water. The background shows more karst formations under a light blue sky. At the bottom right are a barcode, a QR code, and publication details: "16-22 JUNI 2024", "RP 60.000", "TEMPO.CO/MINGGUAN", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", and "ISSN: 0126-4273".
